verdict.rationale: Perplexity Computer is documented as an agent that users hand complex, multi-step work to. It holds a back-and-forth with the user: it asks for more information and requests approval for sensitive actions. That clearly implies operation through conversational commands across many task types (web, code, documents, email, connectors). However, the evidence never states verbatim that tasks are given as natural-language prompts, and no hands-on report shows conversational operation working in practice. missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation that commands are natural-language prompts, documentation of the native Computer UI's conversational interface, independent or hands-on corroboration of natural-language operation quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: your MCP client can delegate complex, multi-step work to Computer and receive structured results.
Relays answers when Computer asks for more information.
Approves or denies a sensitive action like sending an email or deploying code.
Reuse that `thread_id` on later calls to continue the same session.
